exposure: Gut microbiota types (Staphylococcus epidermidis-predominant, Enterobacteriaceae-predominant, anaerobes-rich)
cohort: The study included a cohort of 40 early preterm infants less than 33-weeks-gestation.
finding: The study demonstrated a critical role for both immunological and microbiological factors, including specific gut microbiota types and fecal cytokine profiles, in the early development of intestinal barrier, intestinal permeability, and gut homeostasis in early preterm infants.
